You don't say every letter in a word in English pronunciation. Some letters are silent, which means that you don't hear them as you would pronounce them normally.

In words like honest, hour, or honor, the letter h is silent.
In words like character or choir, the letter h is also silent. It does not combine with another consonant to produce a consonant blend.

Here are examples of the silent letter h in words. Practice saying the example sentences.

If a word ends in a consonant +/t/ and is linked with another word beginning with a consonant, the final /t/ letter is dropped.  This frequently occurs when using the word must.

If you delete the final /t/, the sound before the /t/ must link smoothly into the next word.

You must be happy = You mus_be happy

When the word have follows must, have is reduced to "_ov" or "_av". The 't' sound joins the reduced have.

must have = mus_tuv or mus_tav

Matt: Hey Peter! How have you been? Any luck with the girls since the last time we spoke?
Peter: To be honest, I have no idea anymore. I've tried everything: online dating, speed dating, spending hours and hours in all the comic book stores in town … Honestly, nothing seems to work. So, last week I decided to see a psychic.
Matt: Are you serious? That sounds totally out of character! You must be really desperate at this point! So, what did she see in her crystal ball?
Peter: Very funny! She came up with a whole list of new activities I should try, actually. She said that I might find the girl of my dreams in a song.
Matt: What does that even mean? She must be crazy!

Peter: I don't know about that, but I followed her advice and joined a choir.
Matt: You did what? You must be completely crazy, too.
Peter: It's a lot of fun, believe me. We practice every weekend in a big concert hall. I love how our voices echo in that huge space. The feeling is incredible.
Matt: It must make you feel good, I guess. Anyway, was the psychic right in the end?
Peter: Well, there's this girl ...

Matt: Please tell me you have her number!
Peter: Almost. She whispered in my ear when we were singing, so I couldn't hear the last digit.
Matt: She must be waiting for you to call her then!
Peter: It's alright. I tried every combination until I got it right!
